companyTable.empty: No companies yet. Click "Add company" in the top-right corner and fill in the asset scope; the system will automatically claim matching assets.

delete.title: Confirm delete
delete.description: This will permanently delete <num>{count}</num> asset records. This action cannot be undone.

companyDelete.title: Delete company · {name}
companyDelete.description: This will permanently delete the company and its asset scope configuration. This action cannot be undone.
companyDelete.alsoDeleteAssets: Also delete all assets under this company
companyDelete.alsoDeleteAssetsHint: Leave unchecked to keep the assets and only remove the ownership

companyDialog.title: Add company
companyDialog.description: Configure the company and its asset scope. Keywords only serve as agent hints and do not automatically assign assets.
companyDialog.namePlaceholder: e.g. Acme Corp (name must be unique)

editScope.title: Edit asset scope · {name}
editScope.description: Saving replaces all existing scopes. ICP matches assets exactly; company keywords only serve as agent hints.

appendScope.title: Append asset scope · {name}
appendScope.description: New scopes are appended to the existing ones. ICP matches assets exactly; company keywords only serve as agent hints.

toasts.fixInvalidScope: Please fix the invalid asset scope
toasts.companyCreatedWithInvalid: Company created, {added} scopes added; {invalid} invalid lines
toasts.companyExists: Company already exists; try a different name
toasts.enterScopesToAppend: Please enter the scopes to append
